name: Dr. Jane Smith
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
bio: Researcher in machine learning and artificial intelligence, focused on developing interpretable AI systems for healthcare applications.
aboutDetailed: Welcome to my academic website! I am an Assistant Professor at Stanford University working on machine learning and artificial intelligence. My research focuses on developing interpretable AI systems, particularly for healthcare applications. I completed my PhD at MIT and have published extensively in top-tier venues including NeurIPS, ICML, and Nature Medicine.
